key_reasoning.reason: ledger_figures.py (cached ledger reads and overlay helpers for totals, tiles, pie, people and shared-project rows) and handler.py wiring; all reads go through the existing spend_service port and ledger_coverage, so no new abstraction and no new response keys.

Closest pattern is the prior EPMCDME-17194 hourly-ledger commits. New risk is limited to the per-view cache key (window, access scope, names), never caching an incomplete ledger answer, and null-below-floor semantics. The caller's access scope is applied on every read, so the security aspect is covered by the existing pattern. The edge cases are covered by the new tests.
